setup.title: Setup Instructions
setup.subtitle: Configure {{siteName}} for log collection
setup.docker_intro: Deploy the collectors on your Docker host to start collecting logs and metrics.
setup.docker_log_description: Collects real-time logs from all or specific containers on your host.
setup.docker_run_description: Run the command above on your Docker host...
setup.docker_stats_description: Collects resource usage metrics (CPU, Memory, Network) from your containers.
setup.docker_stats_note: This collector gathers performance data from the Docker engine every 60 seconds.
setup.docker_compose_description: Run both collectors together using a compose file. This is the recommended way for production.
setup.kubernetes_intro: Monitor your Kubernetes cluster with two specialized collectors.
setup.k8s_stats_description: Collects cluster-wide metrics like node status, pod counts, and resource usage.
setup.k8s_logs_description: Streams real-time logs from specific pods in your cluster.
setup.generic_intro: Use the HTTP API to send logs from any platform.
setup.docker_compose_save_hint: Save the snippet above as docker-compose.yml and start both services:
setup.k8s_step_create_namespace: Create the stackradar-system namespace if it doesn't exist.
setup.k8s_step_apply_secret: Apply the configuration secret shown above.
setup.k8s_step_deploy_stats: Deploy the stats collector from the collector-k8s/stats-collector directory.
setup.k8s_step_update_env_vars: In collector-k8s/log-collector/deployment.yaml, update the environment variables to target your pod.
setup.helm_oci_note: Charts are published to the OCI registry. No helm repo add needed.
setup.helmfile_intro: Install helmfile from https://helmfile.readthedocs.io, then run helmfile apply.
setup.helmfile_save_hint: Save this file as helmfile.yaml and run helmfile apply to deploy both collectors.
setup.lambda_intro: Deploy the Log Forwarder Lambda and Metrics Collector Lambda to start monitoring your AWS Lambda functions.
setup.lambda_step1_description: Deploy the StackRadar Log Forwarder Lambda function in your AWS account. Set the following environment variables on the function.
setup.lambda_step2_description: For each Lambda function you want to monitor, create a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter pointing to the Log Forwarder Lambda. Repeat this command for each function.
setup.lambda_step3_description: Deploy the StackRadar Metrics Collector Lambda. This function queries CloudWatch metrics for all your Lambda functions and forwards them to StackRadar.
setup.lambda_step4_description: Create an EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke the Metrics Collector Lambda every 5 minutes.
setup.lambda_iam_description: Attach the following IAM policy to the execution role of the Metrics Collector Lambda.
